newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group upgraded.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it upgraded Apollo Group Inc to outperform from market performer to reflect a more than 35-percent pullback from the recent high of nearly $38 a share and expectations of continued strong enrollment growth and earnings performance.

-- Apollo Group, the fastest growing participant in the for-profit private degree granting higher education market, is now selling at a level that is reasonable based on growth expectations of 30 percent a year on average for the next five years, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said its earnings estimate remains at $0.08 a share for the second quarter, at $0.59 for the year ending in August and at $0.76 in fiscal 1998.
-- Apollo Group shares were up 3/4 Wednesday at 24-7/8.
